reader_notes: I could not tell whether the eleven implant removals sit inside or outside the forty-one whose infection was controlled at six months; 41 + 11 = 52 of 63 left me doing arithmetic that did not resolve. It does not touch q3 (the key only uses the forty-one), so non-blocking.
q2 distractor C is a good trap: it reuses the “some four hundred sequenced” figure as though those phages had been given to patients.

The attitude item (q5) is properly anchored – “which is worth saying before any of the numbers that follow” and “that trial, not any series, will decide” – and C is cleanly excluded because the readier position is explicitly Quilvey’s, not the writer’s.
q4 turns on a single count (nine of thirty-four), which is stated plainly enough that the item is a reading item rather than a numeracy one.
